coder_notes: Trial tests the timing (neoadjuvant, before resection) of radiotherapy with concurrent temozolomide versus the Stupp protocol, so temozolomide is coded established_therapy_experiment in the experimental arm and control_comparator in the Stupp arm (OTHER-type arm works as control). 5-ALA is for fluorescence-guided resection only (diagnostic_agent); it is mentioned only in the experimental arm text. Entry text requires 'high-grade glioma' clinically, with IDH-wildtype GBM confirmed at biopsy.
